name: Modjo
description:
Connect Claude to Modjo, the conversation intelligence platform that captures every sales interaction across your revenue team. Stop digging through your CRM — ask Claude anything about your pipeline and get sales-ready answers grounded in what actually happened.

You can use the Modjo connector to:
- Prepare for your next meetings: "I have a call with Acme Corp in 30 minutes. Give me a brief on where we stand, what we discussed last time, next steps that were discussed and what to focus on during the call."
- Automate your meeting follow up: "Summarize my call with John at Acme , list the action items on my side, and draft a follow-up email recapping next steps"
- Prioritize your pipeline: "Review my open pipeline and rank the deals by where I should focus. Flag anything stalled and tell me the next move on each."
- Coach your reps on key deals: "Score rep's top open deals against MEDDPICC and tell me where to focus our next 1:1."
- Revive lost opportunities: “Considering all the opportunities I closed lost last quarter, which ones have potential to be reopened?”

_published_faq.name: How do I add Modjo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Modjo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.mcp.modjo.ai/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Modjo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modjo provides these MCP tools: ask_anything_on_account, ask_anything_on_call, ask_anything_on_deal, get_accounts, get_agents, get_calendar_events, get_calls, get_contacts, get_deals, get_emails, get_transcript, and get_users.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Modjo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Modjo in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Modjo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Modjo is developed by Modjo. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
